Class ScenarioSelectableItem

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.analytics.ScenarioSelectableItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScenarioBenchmarkItem
public class ScenarioSelectableItem extends Object implements ScenarioBenchmarkItem
Data model wrapper representing a scenario selectable within the Comparative Analytics TableView and batch execution pipeline.

Tracks interactive selection state, execution status, headless batch queue state, wall-clock execution duration estimates \(\tau_{\mathrm{est}}\), and remaining duration \(\tau_{\mathrm{rem}}\).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • ScenarioSelectableItem

      public ScenarioSelectableItem(Scenario scenario, boolean isSelected, boolean executed, String runId)
      Constructs a selectable item for a given scenario.
      Parameters:
      scenario - the underlying scenario definition
      isSelected - initial checkbox selection flag
      executed - whether a historical or simulated run already exists
      runId - the associated simulation run identifier or "HISTORICAL_GROUND_TRUTH"
